svg.text: Nutanix AHV HCI Cluster Deployment Workflow
Guide-aligned process | v1.8.5-rc1 | 27 October 2026 | Day 0 to early Day 1
START Approved design > Validate > Approve > Execute > Verify > Accept
Stop at failed gates. Keep deployment progress, configuration completion and verified readiness separate.
YAML. Save it in Config Files
Open the new PE cluster VIP
When PC is ready, register PE

Use one reviewed configuration set per cluster. Each eligible step binds an action and saved file; steps run sequentially. A required FAIL or CAN'T VERIFY stops later steps. Configure Cluster may run internal actions concurrently; earlier writes are not rolled back.
Approval-required workflows use the direct approved-job path when pipelines cannot bind the approval. Do not weaken policy to enable chaining.
Conditional password + fresh login > EULA / Pulse > DNS / NTP > VM networks / storage > optional HA / local admins > PC registration > independent verification
The journey does not create or run a pipeline. Save and continue retains browser journey state only; save the actual YAML separately. A green job is not proof that every
Revision 3 | Aligned to the attached 27 October 2026 guide. Process design; not a new live deployment validation.
Keep secure credential references and sanitized evidence. Native Foundation planning / controlled-adapter limits remain feature-specific.
